title: A re-pick after the day's quota is spent cannot join its live batch
evidence: US-12 AC25 joins only while the IP and the machine have quota: a spent day gets the 64 KB body cap and the daily limit before any match (app/routes/api.lab-import-v2.ts bodyLimit, daySpent). Admitting full bodies over quota (PR 1442 round 1) was removed: the join is decided only after reading up to 200 MB. Needs design: a join decided without reading the body, for example a rejoin allowance reserved on the batch when it is created and claimed by a small request (batch id plus poll token) before the pages are sent
